scope: Smoother action rendering and larger tier win screens. Native assets/math unchanged.
changes: Shared deadline-based 60Hz renderer replaces rounding-sensitive 30Hz cap
Symbol idle painting capped at 30Hz; landing/paying/removal/gate/win animation can render at 60Hz
Immutable quantized region caches avoid high-quality downsampling original PNGs every frame
Seeded event tracks share base attachments/bones; no reparsing entire rig per removal
Covered board Spine rigs freeze while a win/bonus overlay is open
Coins use shared clock, cached particle-sized texture, <=1.5 DPR
Win view tightened to 860x600 with +20 vertical registration; width cap 106dvh/1000px instead of 78dvh/760px; live amount follows same updated viewBox
Developer-only ?motionStats=true diagnostics: bounded local samples, no network

measurements.context: Same local Chrome dev-only scripted board preview; 180-frame rolling samples. Single desktop/browser, not device certification.

validation.tests: 86/86 PASS: 60/120/144Hz scheduling, hidden-tab resume, RAF cleanup, bounded mip cache/metrics, complete crown/horn bounds for all five tiers, seeded data isolation
validation.build: PASS; existing shared CSS/env warnings remain
validation.browser: Desktop enlarged Legendary art and coin fountain, portrait and short-landscape fit; no app errors

risks: Measured FPS varies by device/browser/load; 60Hz is an action-render target, not universal guarantee.
Low-end physical mobile performance not measured.
